scope: pulse_1 whole-line linear temporal spectral instability only

profile_seed.identity_boundary: pulse_1 is the saved floating representative of the primary symmetric homoclinic selected by P2c; the NPZ truncation is not itself the proof object

true_profile_import.selected_object: the P2c primary first-hit symmetric homoclinic at (r,a2,epsilon)=(2/25,0,1)

tail_import.usable_bounds: |Gamma(xi)| <= 1.082*exp(-|xi|/5) outside the source-to-symmetry compact segment and source-to-symmetry time > 9.6

minimal_inputs: the P2c true selected homoclinic at the frozen parameter point
an outward-rounded integral on the same P2c Krawczyk root
the imported P2c exponential tail bound
the whole-line operator-pencil theorem with an explicit essential-spectrum gap

nonclaims: The saved finite-window pulse arrays are not an enclosure of the true whole-line profile.
The conclusion is a positive real L2 point eigenvalue, not a full spectral census.
The background essential spectrum touches the imaginary axis at plus or minus i; no nonlinear instability theorem is asserted.
Independent replay is required before promotion to a public computer-assisted claim.
